`input-12mp-single.avif` is a locally generated synthetic AVIF image used to test AVIF decoding. It is 4000 × 3000 pixels, encoded from a deterministic test chart, and contains no third-party image content. `input-48mp-grid.avif` is a locally generated 8000 × 6000 AVIF grid used to verify the 12 MP source-pixel limit; it contains no third-party image content.

`input-2mp.avif` and `input-6mp.avif` are generated from the same chart for size-specific Worker benchmarks. All fixtures are synthetic and contain no third-party image content.
